# denut library classification spec (read by tracker/index.html; see library_ranges.md for evidence).
# Functions are sorted by address and classified in this order:
#   1. force  START END LIB   - everything in [START, END) is LIB, no exceptions.
#   2. unknown/weak REGEX     - auto-generated or caller-derived names carry no evidence; class "?".
#      name   LIB REGEX       - otherwise the first matching rule gives the class (LIB "game" = game code).
#      anything else          - "game".
#   3. block  START END LIB   - inside [START, END), "game" and "?" become LIB unless a keepgame REGEX matches.
#   4. a remaining "?" takes its neighbours' library when the nearest anchors before and after agree, else "game".
#      noanchor LIBS          - classes that never act as anchors.
#      noabsorb START END     - a "?" inside this range always stays "game".
# Ranges are [START, END) in hex. Regexes are case-sensitive JavaScript regexes.

noanchor stl,compiler-eh,import

# Static initializers (__dyninit, atexit) mix game and library globals, so unknowns there stay game.
noabsorb 0x82CED3D8 0x82D021CC

# Import thunks and the .embsec_ segments.
force 0x82D021CC 0x82D59800 import

# Contiguous library blocks (evidence in library_ranges.md).
block 0x82634678 0x8264DC00 d3d
block 0x8264DC00 0x8266A098 xaudio
block 0x826D5CC0 0x826D9028 d3d
block 0x826D9028 0x826EE000 xact
block 0x826EE000 0x826FE440 xapi
block 0x826FE440 0x827EF000 d3dx
block 0x827EF000 0x8291ADC0 xgraphics
block 0x8291ADC0 0x829FA1B8 havok
block 0x82A03E60 0x82A05990 xapi
block 0x82A05990 0x82A67AE0 xui
block 0x82A67AE0 0x82B48640 xmv
block 0x82B6E608 0x82BBF178 xts
block 0x82BBF178 0x82BC32D0 fontcache
block 0x82BC7E08 0x82BE9248 pathengine
block 0x82BE9248 0x82BEADF0 xapi
block 0x82BEADF0 0x82BF3C48 fontcache
block 0x82C08000 0x82C29000 crt
block 0x82C29000 0x82C2A400 xapi
block 0x82C2A400 0x82C43000 havok
block 0x82C68760 0x82CED3D8 pathengine

# Game functions that sit inside a block.
keepgame ^(HavokSystem_|AnimEventCursor|AnimPlayhead|RenderGraph)
